title: NFL Jersey Quiz Part 3: Hard Mode
headline: NFL Jersey Quiz Part 3: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Jersey
description: A hard NFL jersey quiz: eight tiny squares cut from current NFL jerseys, no numbers, no wordmarks, no logos. Just a stripe, a collar or a shoulder. Guess the team, reveal the answer, keep score.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NFL jersey, about one sixtieth of the whole picture. No numbers, no wordmarks, no logo patches. What is left is the stuff fans stop noticing: a sleeve stripe, a collar, a shoulder panel.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.fact: Washington became the Commanders in February 2022.

items.piece: Red and white stripes on the orange sleeve.
items.fact: Tampa Bay wore this orange, nicknamed Creamsicle, from 1976 to 1996 and brought it back as a throwback in 2023.

items.piece: Navy, red and white stripes on the light blue sleeve.
items.fact: The franchise was the Houston Oilers until it moved to Tennessee in 1997, and it became the Titans in 1999.

items.piece: The old gold collar on the black jersey.
items.fact: New Orleans has worn black and gold since its first season in 1967.

items.piece: Red and white stripes on the royal blue sleeve.
items.fact: Buffalo went back to royal blue in 2011, with a redesign based on its 1970s uniforms.

items.piece: A Panther blue stripe edged in silver running down the black shoulder.
items.fact: Carolina's colors are black, Panther blue and silver, the same three since its first season in 1995.
